title: 神奈川県公立高校入試形式　オリジナル模試（第2回）　英語

sec.ins: リスニングテスト（放送の指示にしたがって答えなさい。放送を聞きながらメモをとってもかまいません。）
次の英文の（　）の中に入れるのに最も適するものを、あとの1～4の中からそれぞれ一つずつ選び、その番号を答えなさい。
次の英文の（　）の中に入れるのに最も適するものを、あとの1～4の中からそれぞれ一つずつ選び、その番号を答えなさい。
次の(ア)～(エ)の対話が成り立つように、（　）内の六つの語の中から五つを選んで正しい順番に並べたとき、その（　）内で3番目と5番目にくる語の番号をそれぞれ答えなさい。（それぞれ一つずつ不要な語があるので、その語は使用しないこと。）
次の英文は、中学生の Nana が英語の授業で行ったスピーチの原稿です。英文を読んで、あとの各問いに答えなさい。
次の(ア)の英文と List、(イ)の英文と Poster について、それぞれあとの問いに答えなさい。
次の英文を読んで、あとの各問いに答えなさい。

E2-L1.c:
Ms. Baker: Haruto, you look happy. What happened?
Haruto: My sister started working in Osaka, so I'm going to visit her during the winter vacation.
Ms. Baker: That's nice. How are you going to get there?
Haruto: (チャイム)

E2-L2.c:
Haruto: Mom, have you seen my blue notebook? I need it for my science class today.
Mother: I saw a blue notebook on the table in the living room this morning.
Haruto: I looked there, but it wasn't there.
Mother: Then maybe your brother took it by mistake. He has a blue notebook, too.
Haruto: (チャイム)

E2-L3.c:
Yui: Haruto, the school festival is next Friday. Have you finished making the poster for our class?
Haruto: Not yet. I've drawn the picture, but I haven't written the words.
Yui: Can I help you? I'm good at writing big letters.
Haruto: (チャイム)

E2-L4.c:
Mei: Sota, did you watch the soccer game on TV last night?
Sota: No, I couldn't. I had to finish my homework. Who won?
Mei: Japan did. The score was 2 to 1. Japan got the winning goal in the last five minutes.
Sota: Wow! I wish I had watched it.
Mei: My father recorded the game. You can watch it at my house this Saturday if you want.
Sota: Really? Thanks! I'll come at ten.
Question: What can we say about Sota?

E2-L5.c:
Clerk: Hello. May I help you?
Ms. Baker: Yes. I'm looking for a T-shirt for my son. He's ten years old.
Clerk: How about this one? It's popular among children. We have it in blue and green.
Ms. Baker: He likes green, but this one looks a little big for him.
Clerk: Then how about this smaller green one? It's 1,500 yen.
Ms. Baker: Perfect. I'll take it.
Question: What can we say about Ms. Baker?

E2-L6.c:
Hello, everyone. I'm Mr. Hill. Today I'm going to tell you about the English Camp this summer. The camp will be held for three days, from August 7 to August 9, at Hikari Lake Youth House. About thirty students from five junior high schools will join it.
On the first day, you will make groups and cook dinner together. On the second day, you will climb a mountain with teachers from five countries and talk about nature in English. On the last day, each group will make a short play in English and show it to everyone.
When I was a student, I was afraid of making mistakes, so I didn't speak much in English class. But at a camp like this one, I found that people listened to me even when my English was not perfect. Mistakes are a part of learning. So please don't worry, and try to speak a lot. If you want to join the camp, please give the form to your English teacher by July 10. Thank you.

E2-CHAT.c:
（ア）Yui and Sota are classmates. Their ALT, Mr. Lopez, is going back to his country next month. They want to buy a present for him. They are sending messages to each other on Friday night.

Yui (19:02)：Mr. Lopez loves cooking, so let's buy a cooking tool for him. Can you go shopping with me tomorrow?
Sota (19:05)：Sure. I found a list of shops near Hikari Station. Look at the List below.
Yui (19:08)：Thanks. I want to take enough time to choose a good one, so let's stay at the shop for one hour.
Sota (19:10)：OK. I have basketball practice at school until 1:00 tomorrow, and it takes 30 minutes from school to the station. I want to have lunch at home after practice, so let's meet as late as possible.
Yui (19:12)：All right. I have a piano lesson at 4:30, so I need to be back at the station by 4:00.
Sota (19:14)：Then let's go to a shop that sells cooking tools and is open tomorrow afternoon. We'll walk from the station. Let's meet at the station at [[blank:　　]].
Yui (19:15)：OK. See you tomorrow!

E2-POSTER.c:
（イ）Kaho and Daiki are junior high school students. They are talking with Mr. Hill, their English teacher, about a video contest.

Mr. Hill：Kaho, Daiki, you want to join this contest, right?
Kaho：Yes. We want to make a video about Hikari River. It's our favorite place in our town.
Daiki：Let's start taking videos of the river this weekend!
Kaho：Wait, Daiki. Look at the poster. In Round 1, we only send a plan. If we don't pass it, we can't send a video.
Daiki：You're right. But we have to decide which part of the river we'll show before we write the plan. There are many good places.
Mr. Hill：That's true. After you write the plan, bring it to me. I'll check your English before you send it.
Kaho：Thank you. If we pass Round 1, we want to take videos of the fireworks festival by the river on July 5.
Daiki：Then we'll *edit the video after the festival and send it before the deadline.
Mr. Hill：Good plan. And if you are chosen for the final, you'll need to practice your speech.

r: Send a plan for your video (in English, about 100 words).
Teams that pass Round 1 (results: June 20) send a 3-minute video.
Show your video and make a speech at Hikari City Hall.
tb.c: Poster：Hikari City Video Contest ― "The Best Place in Our Town"

q.q: （ア）は、対話の最後の発言に続くものとして最も適するものを、次の1～4の中から一つずつ選び、その番号を答えなさい。
c: She works at a hotel there.
By train. It takes about three hours.
q.e: 最後に How are you going to get there?（そこへどうやって行くのか）と交通手段をたずねているので、By train.（電車で）と答えている1が適切。

q.q: 放送される対話を聞いて答えなさい。
c: No, I don't have science class today.
Oh, I'll look for it on his desk.
Yes, it's on the table now.
Sure, you can use my notebook.
q.e: 母親が「弟（兄）がまちがえて持っていったのかもしれない」と言っているので、「彼の机の上を探してみる」と答える1が自然な流れ。

q.q: 放送される対話を聞いて、Haruto の最後の発言として最も適するものを選びなさい。
c: Sorry, I've never been to the festival.
Yes, I drew the picture last week.
Thank you. Can you come to the art room after school?
No, the festival was last Friday.
q.e: Yui が Can I help you?（手伝おうか）と申し出ているので、お礼を言って放課後に来てくれるよう頼む1が適切。

q.q:
（イ）は、対話を聞いて、それぞれの質問の答えとして最も適するものを、次の1～4の中から一つずつ選び、その番号を答えなさい。
質問：What can we say about Sota?
c: He finished his homework at Mei's house.
He got a goal in the last five minutes of the game.
He watched the game with his father last night.
He is going to watch the game at Mei's house on Saturday.
q.e: Mei が「父が試合を録画した。土曜日にうちで見られるよ」と言い、Sota は I'll come at ten. と答えているので1が適切。

q.q: 質問：What can we say about Ms. Baker?
c: She is going to buy a blue T-shirt for herself.
She wants a bigger T-shirt because her son is tall.
She thinks the T-shirt is too expensive.
She is going to buy a smaller green T-shirt for her son.
q.e: 息子は緑が好きだが最初のシャツは少し大きいと言い、店員がすすめた小さいサイズの緑のシャツを I'll take it. と買うことにしたので1が適切。

q.q:
（ウ）は、英語の先生の Mr. Hill が、サマーキャンプについて生徒に話しています。次の＜ワークシート＞は、生徒の Aoi が話を聞きながら書いたものです。
＜ワークシート＞
　English Camp（August 7 – August 9）
　・About thirty students from （ ① ） junior high schools will join.
　・On the second day, we will （ ② ）.
　・We have to give the form to our English teacher by （ ③ ）.
　・Mr. Hill's message：（ ④ ）

＜ワークシート＞の（ ① ）～（ ③ ）の中に入れるものとして最も適するものをそれぞれＡ～Ｃの中から一つずつ選んだときの組み合わせとして最も適するものを、あとの1～9の中から一つ選び、その番号を答えなさい。
①　A. five　　B. thirty　　C. three
②　A. cook dinner together　　B. make a short play　　C. climb a mountain
③　A. July 10　　B. August 7　　C. August 9
q.e: ① about thirty students from five junior high schools より five（A）。② On the second day, you will climb a mountain より（C）。③ give the form to your English teacher by July 10 より（A）。よって ①-A ②-C ③-A。

q.q: ＜ワークシート＞の（ ④ ）の中に入れるものとして最も適するものを、次の1～4の中から一つ選び、その番号を答えなさい。
c: Don't be afraid of making mistakes, and try to speak a lot.
Practice English hard before the camp so that you won't make mistakes.
Make a short play in English with your family.
Speak English only when you are sure your English is perfect.
q.e: Mr. Hill は Mistakes are a part of learning. So please don't worry, and try to speak a lot. と伝えている。自分の経験（まちがいを恐れて話さなかった）も話の中心なので1が適切。

q.q: This bag is too (　　　) for me to carry. Can you help me?
q.e: too ～ for … to ―「…が―するには～すぎる」。運ぶのを手伝ってほしいのだから heavy（重い）が適切。

q.q: There is a big (　　　) near my house. I often go there to borrow books.
q.e: 本を借りに行く場所なので library（図書館）が適切。

q.q: I couldn't (　　　) the answer to the last question, so I asked my teacher about it.
q.e: find the answer で「答えを見つける」。答えがわからなかったので先生に聞いた、という流れ。

q.q:
A：How long have you lived in Hikari City?
B：I (　　　) here since I was five.
q.e: since I was five（5歳のときから）と、過去から現在まで続く状態を表しているので現在完了 have lived が適切。

q.q:
A：Which do you want to drink, tea or coffee?
B：(　　　) is fine. I like both of them.
q.e: 二つのうち「どちらでも」は either。I like both of them. とあるので「どちらでもいい」となる Either が適切。

q.q:
A：Do you know (　　　) the next bus will come?
B：In ten minutes, I think.
q.e: 間接疑問。B が In ten minutes（10分後に）と時を答えているので when が適切。

q.q:
A：Thank you for (　　　) me with my homework.
B：You're welcome.
q.e: 前置詞 for の後ろに動詞を置くときは動名詞（～ing）にする。Thank you for helping me. で「手伝ってくれてありがとう」。

q.q:
A：This cake is delicious! Did you make it?
B：Yes. My grandmother （　1. how　2. make　3. taught　4. what　5. to　6. me　） it.
▶（ア）の（　）内で3番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：taught me how to make（不要な語：what）。teach ＋人＋how to ～ で「（人）に～のしかたを教える」。3番目は how。

q.q: ▶（ア）の（　）内で5番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：taught me how to make（不要な語：what）。how to make it で「それの作り方」。5番目は make。

q.q:
A：Whose umbrella is this?
B：I think it belongs to （　1. girl　2. is　3. the　4. talking　5. who　6. which　） with Ms. Baker over there.
▶（イ）の（　）内で3番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：the girl who is talking（不要な語：which）。人を説明する主格の関係代名詞は who。the girl who is talking で「話している女の子」。3番目は who。

q.q: ▶（イ）の（　）内で5番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：the girl who is talking（不要な語：which）。who の後ろは is talking（現在進行形）。5番目は talking。which は人以外に使うので不要。

q.q:
A：Have you finished your report for the English class?
B：No. It's （　1. write　2. of　3. difficult　4. to　5. me　6. for　） in English.
▶（ウ）の（　）内で3番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：difficult for me to write（不要な語：of）。It is ～ for ＋人＋ to … で「（人）にとって…することは～だ」。difficult for me と続くので3番目は me。

q.q: ▶（ウ）の（　）内で5番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：difficult for me to write（不要な語：of）。to の後ろは動詞の原形 write。5番目は write。of は It is kind of you のように人の性質を表す形容詞のときに使うので不要。

q.q:
A：What did you think of the movie?
B：It was the （　1. ever　2. movie　3. exciting　4. I've　5. most　6. more　） seen.
▶（エ）の（　）内で3番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：most exciting movie I've ever（不要な語：more）。the most ＋形容詞＋名詞 で最上級。the most exciting movie と続くので3番目は movie。

q.q: ▶（エ）の（　）内で5番目にくる語
q.e: 正しい順：most exciting movie I've ever（不要な語：more）。movie を I've ever seen（今までに見た）が後ろから説明する。5番目は ever。more は比較級で the とは使わないので不要。

q.q:
次のＡ～Ｃの絵と英文は、中学生の Sota と、カナダからの留学生の Tom の間の出来事を表しています。Ｂの場面で、Sota は何と言ったと考えられますか。あとの＜条件＞にしたがって、[[blank:　　]]の中に入れるのに適する英文を書きなさい。

＜最初の英文＞
Sota found a poster at Hikari Station. It was about Hikari Aquarium.

＜条件＞
①　aquarium, new, opens の3語を必ず用いること。
②　[[blank:　　]]内を7語以上の1文で書くこと。
③　[[blank:　　]]のあとに続く Do you want to go there with me? につながる内容にすること。
※　短縮形（I'm など）は1語と数え、符号（, など）は語数に含めません。
q.a: A new penguin area opens at Hikari Aquarium on April 29.
q.e: ポスター（Ａ）には「新しいペンギンエリアが4月29日にオープンする」とある。Ｃで Tom が I love penguins. と答えているので、Ｂでは新しいペンギンのエリアができることを伝え、そのあとの Do you want to go there with me? につなげる。opens は主語が3人称単数の現在形（決まった予定を表す）なので、主語は A new ～ area のように単数にする。別解例：Hikari Aquarium opens a new area for penguins this month.（10語）など。
